guides.title: Install Hazri and first run
guides.ex: Welcome, Language and How you read: three screens and you are on Today.

guides.title: Mark your daily Hazri
guides.ex: One finished paath or five minutes of Naam Simran marks the day.

guides.title: Read and listen to a bani with the recitation
guides.ex: Follow audio, speed, the sleep timer and Start again, line by line.

guides.title: Play all for the morning Nitnem
guides.ex: The five Amrit Vela banis one after another, with the phone locked.

guides.title: Set your daily paath goal
guides.ex: A bani or Naam Simran, times a day, how long, and a reminder.

guides.title: Turn on on-time reminders
guides.ex: Notifications, Alarms & reminders and battery settings, so reminders arrive to the minute.

guides.title: Sit for Naam Simran and see the globe
guides.ex: Begin a sitting, then read the You, Live and Here today dots.

guides.title: Use the Diary and your streak
guides.ex: Dots for Hazri and goals, now and longest, and + or − for the last 7 days.

guides.title: Join a built-in sangat
guides.ex: Amrit Vela, Simran or Sukhmani Sahib Sangat, with no profile needed.

guides.title: Create your own sangat group and set a goal
guides.ex: Name it, choose one goal and an end date, then invite.

guides.title: Invite family with a link or code
guides.ex: Share the invite, or join with an eight-character code.

guides.title: Make a profile and verify your email
guides.ex: Name, email and city; a link instead of a password.

guides.title: Back up and restore your goals and diary
guides.ex: The weekly backup, Back up now, and bringing it all back on a new phone.

guides.title: Share Today’s Vichar as an image
guides.ex: Send the day’s line as an image card or as text.

guides.title: Earn badges
guides.ex: Ten badges counted in days, and where to see them.

guides.title: Elder mode, dark mode and languages
guides.ex: Larger text, a dark theme, and the app in Punjabi, Hindi or English.
